_comment: Curated provenance metadata for the pdf-match test PDFs (hand-maintained, not generated). Per-docid keys: `description` (required); `sourcePath` (optional) — path to a local PDF to copy in, absolute or relative to the repo root, for documents that aren't downloadable or that a user has on disk; `downloadUrl` (optional) — direct PDF download URL; `doi` (optional) — used by fetch-sources.js to re-resolve a download URL via Unpaywall/Crossref if `downloadUrl` is absent or fails; `sha256` (optional) — integrity check that guards against the publisher silently replacing the file, which would invalidate the committed gold cases in fixtures/ and cases/; if omitted, fetch-sources.js prints the computed hash so it can be pinned later. Resolution precedence in fetch-sources.js: existing file on disk -> sourcePath -> downloadUrl -> doi. `resolvedVia` (optional, informational) notes how the downloadUrl was originally discovered by hand (landing-page or unpaywall).
